issues.issue: Would the appellant face a serious possibility of persecution from police or the brother in the internal flight cities (New Delhi, Mumbai, Calcutta)?
issues.applicant_position: Authorities have tools to find him, such as tenant registration, and would likely track him down to extort or persecute him.
issues.result_text: RPD was correct that he has not shown a serious possibility of persecution if relocating to the internal flight cities.

issues.issue: Would relocating to the internal flight cities be unreasonable?
issues.result_text: No argument that relocation would be unreasonable; he is a young man with factory work experience.
